name: How does Frasheski Construction coordinate plumbing with other trades like HVAC and electrical?

mainEntity.name: How does Frasheski Construction coordinate plumbing with other trades like HVAC and electrical?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction utilizes a comprehensive pre-construction planning phase where our project managers facilitate collaborative meetings between plumbing, HVAC, and electrical contractors. We often employ 3D modeling and Building Information Modeling (BIM) tools to visualize potential clashes and optimize routing before construction begins. This integrated approach ensures that all systems have dedicated space, proper clearances, and do not impede each other's function or future access. Our process clarity aims to identify and resolve potential conflicts digitally, long before any physical work starts on your site.
acceptedAnswer.description: We coordinate plumbing with other trades through collaborative planning and 3D modeling to prevent clashes and optimize system integration before construction.
